党委书记、董事长：李大鹏

Party Secretary and Board Chairman: Li Dapeng

# 董事长致辞

2020年，面对突如其来的新冠肺炎疫情和严峻复杂经济形势的叠加影响，齐商银行在各级党委政府和监管部门的正确领导及社会各界的大力支持下，坚持稳中求进工作总基调，不畏艰难、拼搏进取，锐意改革、苦干实干，各项业务实现了稳健发展，主要经营指标创造了历史最好成绩。截至2020年末，全行资产总额1,501亿元，较年初增长183亿元，增幅13.87%；各项存款总额1,221亿元，较年初增长114亿元，增幅10.28%；各项贷款总额953亿元，较年初增长139亿元，增幅17.07%；下半年存贷款增长额创成立以来最大单季、单月增幅纪录。全年实现经营利润13.52亿元，净利润5.76亿元，整体经营成果好于预期，开创了“二次创业、再攀高峰”的崭新局面。

一是公司治理机制持续优化。本行认真落实《商业银行公司治理指引》等监管要求，不断加强董事会履职能力建设，公司治理的有效性得到进一步提升。全面落实党委会研究审议的前置程序要求，有效突出党组织在公司治理结构中的领导核心地位。增补三位股东董事，调增董事会下设专门委员会中的独立董事数量，董事会成员结构持续改善。根据银保监会要求，围绕股东大会、董事会、监事会和高管层治理的有效性及合规性，组织开展了公司治理自查评估工作，总结了经验，明确了差距，为公司治理的持续改进提供了最新依据。持续提升股权管理水平，严把股东准入关口，有效评估股东经营管理状况，主动防范有关风险。年内继续推进股权托管工作，股权管理更加科学规范，截至2020年末，已完成全部股权的托管登记以及98%股权的确权工作。及时掌握关联方变动情况，补充认定关联方名单，动态、全面地做好关联方管理工作。依法合规开展关联交易，及时报送关联交易监管信息，信贷管理系统上线“股东和关联方管理”模块，有效防范风险在本行、股东及其关联机构间传染和转移。坚持董事会月度工作部署、高级管理层贯彻落实并定期报告、监事会有效监督的运行机制，加强对高级管理层成员的履职监督与评价考核，董事会战略决策、高级管理层执行落实、监事会监督制衡的协调运行机制更加高效。

二是结构调整更加科学。秉承“有组织、上规模、高层次”的营销理念，扎实开展专项营销活动，自7月末活动开展至年末，各项存款余额净增112亿元。相继与市属龙头企业达成全面战略合作，与国内部分优质企业签署战略合作协议，全年新增贷款近171亿元，授信业务及客户结构持续优化。坚持“零售业务批发做”理念，做深做透供应链金融，年末普惠型小微贷款余额110.3亿元，较年初增长16.5%，全面完成了“两增两控”监管指标，获评“2020年卓越竞争力供应链金融银行”；个人消费贷款余额98.8亿元，较年初增长14.4%；信用卡有效持卡量、授信额度、交易金额均稳中有升，获评“年度信用卡业务发展奖”等荣誉称号。持续扩大债券交易，有效提升自营资金收益水平，再获“全国银行间本币市场最佳进步奖”。全年累计发行理财产品306期、募集资金343亿元，实现中间业务收入同比增长约140%。牢牢把握“存款立行、负债先行”理念，充分发挥产品优势，顺利运营多家助农点，多渠道开展综合营销，储蓄存款余额首次突破400亿元、年末达到420亿元，较年初增长98亿元；大力推动系统性存款准入及大客户营销，年末对公存款余额达到533亿元，负债基础进一步夯实。

三是转型改革焕发活力。本行在认真总结、深刻剖析全行短板差距的基础上，借鉴同业经验，结合自身实际，迈出了全方位改革的坚定步伐，突破了制约发展的重大瓶颈，取得了实质性的积极成效。针对改革发展对优秀人才的需求与现有人力资源支撑力不足的矛盾，一方面面向社会广纳人才，下半年招聘新员工近90人；另一方面选拔行内优秀干部员工组建三级“人才库”，为今后人才梯队建设及选拔任用提供了有力保障；再一方面制定了科学合理的内退转岗政策，鼓励达到标准的干部员工内退转岗并形成常态化机制，人力资源结构得到进一步优化。按照“强总行”思路，突出条线管控和前台营销，充实前台部门、强化中台部门、精简后台部门，为提升总行“管理、引领、支撑、服务”能力提供了体制保障。本着“引入竞争机制、提升决策效率”的原则，在淄博地区增设了一家分行级机构，合并了中心城区6家管辖支行，进一步缩短了管理半径、优化了网点设置、激发了内生活力。大力培育“履职尽责、尽职免责、严肃追责、全程覆盖”的“信贷文化”，着力塑造“立标、对标、达标”的“标杆文化”和“公开、公平、公

正”的“用人文化”，持续倡树激励广大干部员工拼搏创业的“干事文化”和“执行文化”，积极为全员办实事、办好事，进一步增强了全员的归属感、凝聚力和向心力。

四是创新引领亮点纷呈。落实各项政策，小微金融服务实现新拓展，积极响应国家及监管部门号召，加大对防疫企业和遇困小微企业、个体工商户的支持力度，办理无还本续贷1.32亿元，发放普惠小微信用贷款8.72亿元，办理延期还本付息贷款18.77亿元；发放疫情专用支小再贷款超10亿元，居全市首位；发放“人才贷”2.05亿元，居全省城商行首位；发放“纾困贷”1.54亿元，占全市总放款量的90%以上，发放“创业担保贷”3.86亿元，较去年翻了一番，两项产品惠及全市6000余户小微企业，金融辅导工作被省政府主管部门评为省级“优秀”单位。丰富服务功能，网络金融服务跃升新层次，创新推出“e齐税易贷”“纾困e贷”等线上贷款产品，有效提升了客户体验及服务效率。互联网渠道客户数量突破82万户，同比增长18.1%，微信银行交易量居全省城商行首位，网络渠道业务替代率94.3%，居全省城商行第三位，获评中国财经风云榜“杰出手机银行”。直销银行注册客户超过23万户，管理资产规模突破53亿元，较去年同期分别增长130%和44.8%，位居全国城商行前列，获评“2020年度最佳开放银行”。强化科技赋能，支撑业务发展取得新进步，CBUS5.0智慧银行系统顺利上线运行，集中作业中心、移动展业平台等项目为运营创新提供了有效支撑。借助“齐银e链”在线供应链平台，与多家核心企业联合推出“齐银e信”产品，并成功引入区块链技术实现首笔放款，线上供应链业务发展迈入新阶段。多渠道引入权威大数据应用，推出“e齐场景贷”等产品，提升了授信业务审批效率及风控水平。

五是风险防控取得实效。本行全面风险管理暨新资本管理办法实施项目稳步推进，信用风险内评体系项目顺利上线运行，为风险精细化管控提供了有力支撑。授信管控机制持续强化。集中上收了授信审批权限，减少审批节点，优化审批模式，提升了授信业务审批质效；修订启用了新版授信合同，提升了合同文本使用效率；持续规范放款审核工作，各分行放款中心风险防范“最后一道关口”效果显现；优化调整展业区域系统控制规则，异地授信管控能力持续加强。重点领域风险防控持续加力。加强账户管理，开展飞行检查，柜面操作风险管控持续强化；坚持流动性优先原则，科学配置资产负债结构，流动性风险管控水平不断提升；信息安全常抓不懈，有效防范了互联网金融广泛应用带来的信息科技风险；发挥派驻风险经理机制优势，加强市场分析预判，做好投资标的风险监测，提升了市场风险防控成效；稳妥推进央行“贷款市场报价利率”机制改革，实现了平稳有序过渡；科学调配外汇头寸，做好市场风险预警，有效防范了汇率风险；严密监测舆情，加大正面宣传，积极应对处理信访事件，声誉风险防范的主动性持续增强。不良贷款清收处置圆满完成攻坚战目标任务。加强组织领导，强化管控措施，积极争取地方政府支持，全面完成了省委省政府和山东银保监局下达的风险化解三年攻坚战目标任务。

2021年，本行将全面贯彻党的十九大和十九届二中、三中、四中全会以及中央经济工作会议精神，坚持稳中求进工作总基调，立足新发展阶段，贯彻新发展理念，融入新发展格局，秉持“特色办行、人才立行、科技强行、合规治行、服务兴行、文化领行”六大发展理念，大力实施“大零售战略”“强总行战略”和“金融科技战略”三大经营战略，树立“发展提质增效、管理创先争优”的导向，打造“零售普惠优先、公司金融拓展、电子银行升级、同业投行创新”的业务发展模式，构建科学的“精细化管理体系”“综合营销体系”和“政治建设体系”，完善公平公正的人力资源管理体制和业务考核激励机制，促进转型迈向“精细化、智能化、集约化、轻型化”，为“二次创业、再攀高峰”开好局、起好步，推进全行高质量可持续发展再上新台阶，为打造“特色鲜明、管理科学、内控严密、竞争力强”的现代化商业银行而接续奋斗！

# Chairman's Speech

In 2020, in the face of the double impact brought by the sudden outbreak of COVID-19 pandemic and the severe and complex economic situation, under the correct leadership of CPC committees, governments and regulatory departments at all levels and the strong support from various social sectors, Qishang Bank adhered to the general principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, was fearless and difficulties, strived for progress, got determined to reform, worked hard in a down-to-earth way, achieved steady development in various businesses, and created the best performance in main business indicators. By the end of 2020, the Bank had the total assets of RMB 150.1 billion, up by RMB 18.3 billion or 13.87% over the beginning of the year; the total amount of various deposits was RMB 122.1 billion, up by RMB 11.4 billion or 10.28% over the beginning of the year; the total amount of various loans was RMB 95.3 billion, up by RMB 13.9 billion or 17.07% over the beginning of the year; in the second half of the year, the Bank set a new record of the largest growth of deposits and loans in a single quarter and single month growth since its establishment. The Bank realized the operating profit of RMB 1.352 billion and the net profit of RMB 576 million all the year round, with the overall operating results better than expected, creating a brand new situation of "starting a new undertaking and scaling new heights".

Firstly, the Bank continued to optimize the corporate governance mechanism. The Bank conscientiously implemented the Guidelines on Corporate Governance of Commercial Banks and other regulatory requirements, continuously strengthened the capacity-building of the Board of Directors to perform its duties, and further improved the effectiveness of corporate governance. The Bank fully implemented the procedural prerequisite for research and deliberation of the CPC Committee, and effectively highlighted the leading core position of the CPC organization in the corporate governance structure. The Bank supplemented three shareholder directors, increased the number of Independent Directors in the special committees under the Board of Directors so that the member structure of the Board of Directors continued to be improved. According to the requirements of China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, focusing on the effectiveness and compliance of shareholder governance, the Board of Directors, the Board of Supervisors and senior management governance, the Bank organized the implementation of self-examination and evaluation of corporate governance, summarized the experience, and identified gaps, providing the latest basis for the continuous improvement of corporate governance. The Bank continuously improved the level of equity management, strictly controlled the access as shareholders, effectively evaluated the operation and management status of shareholders, and took the initiative to prevent relevant risks. The Bank continued to promote equity trusteeship within the year, and conducted equity management in a more reasonable and standardized way. By the end of 2020, the Bank had completed the trusteeship registration of all equity and the confirmation of 98% of its equity. The Bank continuously strengthened the management of connected transactions, grasped the changes of related parties in time, supplemented and identified the list of related parties, and did a good job in the management of related parties dynamically and comprehensively. The Bank carried out the management of connected transactions according to relevant laws and regulations, submitted relevant information to the connected transaction supervision system in time, and launched the module "Shareholder and Related Party Management" in the credit management system, effectively preventing the transmission and transfer of risks among the Bank, shareholders and their affiliated institutions. The Bank adhered to the operation mechanism of monthly work deployment of the Board of Directors, implementation and regular reporting by senior management as well as effective supervision by the Board of Supervisors, strengthened the supervision of performance of duties, evaluation and assessment of senior management members, and made the coordinated operation mechanism of strategic decision-making of the Board of Directors, implementation and by senior management as well as supervision, check and balance by the Board of Supervisors more efficient.

Secondly, the structural adjustment was reasonable. Adhering to the marketing concept of "being organized, large-scale and high-level", the Bank steadily carried out dedicated marketing activities, and had a net increase of RMB 11.2 billion in the balance of various deposits from late July till the end of the year. The Bank reached comprehensive strategic cooperation with some leading municipal enterprises, signed strategic cooperation agreements with some high-quality domestic enterprises, had the annual new loans of nearly RMB 17.1 billion, and continuously optimized the credit business and customer structure. Adhering to the concept of "running retail business as wholesale business", the Bank deeply and thoroughly enhanced its supply chain finance, with the balance of inclusive loans to small and medium-sized enterprises reaching RMB 11.03 billion at the end of the year, up by 16.5% over the beginning of the year, fully completed the regulatory indicators of "two increases and two controls", and therefore was awarded the "Excellent Competitive Supply Chain Financial Bank 2020"; the balance of personal consumer loans was RMB 9.88 billion, up by 14.4% over the beginning of the year; the number of valid credit cards, credit line and transaction amount all increased steadily, and thereby the Bank won the "Annual Credit Card Business Development Award" and other honorary titles. The Bank continued to expand bond transactions, effectively improved the income level of self-operated funds, and was honored with the "Best Progress Award in the National Inter-bank Currency Market" again. Throughout the year, the Bank issued 306 wealth management products and raised funds of RMB 34.3 billion, realizing a year-on-year growth of intermediate business revenues by about 140%. The Bank firmly upheld the idea of "deposit foremost, liability first", gave full play to its product advantages, smoothly operated a number of agricultural assistance sites, carried out comprehensive marketing through multiple channels, with the balance of savings deposits exceeding RMB 40 billion for the first time, reaching RMB 42 billion at the end of the year, up by RMB 9.8 billion over the beginning of the year; the Bank vigorously promoted systematic deposit access and marketing of major customers, with the balance of corporate deposits reaching RMB 53.3 billion at the end of the year, and the Bank further consolidated its liability foundation.

Thirdly, the transformation and reform were full of vitality. On the basis of conscientiously summarizing and deeply analyzing the weakness and gap of the Bank, drawing on the experience of peers and combining with its own reality, the Bank took firm steps in all-round reform, broke through the major bottleneck restricting its development and achieved substantive positive results. In view of the contradiction between the demand for excellent talents in reform and development and the insufficient support of existing human resources, on the one hand, the Bank widely recruited nearly 90 new employees from society in the second half of the year; on the other hand, the Bank selected outstanding officers and employees internally to form a three-level "talent pool", providing a strong guarantee for the construction, selection and appointment of talent echelon in the future; moreover, the Bank formulated the policy about reasonable early retirement and job transfer to encourage the early retirement and job transfer of officers and employees who meet the standards, forming a normalization mechanism, thus further optimizing the human resource structure. According to the idea of "strengthening the Head Office", the Bank highlighted the line control and front-office marketing, enriched the front-office department, strengthened the middle-office department, and streamlined the back-office department, providing an institutional guarantee for improving the "management, guidance, support and service" ability of the Head Office. Under the principle of "introducing competition mechanism and improving decision efficiency", the Bank established a branch-level institution in Zibo and merged 6 sub-branches in the downtown of the city, further shortening the management radius, optimizing the setup of outlets and stimulating the internal living force. The Bank vigorously cultivated the "credit culture" of "dedicated to work, responsible

for work, strict in accountability and full coverage", focused on shaping the "benchmarking culture" of "establishing standards, checking standards and achieving standards" and the "employment culture" of "open, fair and impartial", continued to promote the "culture of diligence" and the "culture of execution" encouraging officers and employees to work hard with entrepreneurship, actively did practical work and provided good benefits for the whole staff, so as to further enhance their sense of belonging, cohesion and centripetal force.

Fourthly, innovation gave rise to a variety of highlights. The Bank implemented various policies, achieved new expansion in small and micro financial services, actively responded to the call of the state and regulatory authorities, enhancing the support for epidemic prevention enterprises and small and micro enterprises in trouble and privately or individually-owned businesses. It handled RMB 132 million renewed loans without repaying principal, issued RMB 872 million small and micro-inclusive credit loans, and handled RMB 1,877 billion loans extending the repayment of principal and interest; the Bank issued more than RMB 1 billion small reloans for epidemic prevention and control purpose, ranking first in the city. The Bank issued RMB 205 million "talent loans", ranking first in the province's urban commercial banks. The Bank issued RMB 154 million "rescue loans", accounting for more than 90% of the total loans of the city, and issued RMB 386 million "entrepreneurship guaranteed loans", doubling from the previous year. The two products benefited more than 6,000 small and micro enterprises in the city. Due to its financial guidance, the Bank was rated as the "Provincial Excellent Entity" by the competent authority of the provincial government. The Bank increased service functions, made online financial services upgraded to a new level, and innovatively launched online loan products such as "e-Qi Tax and Easy Loan" and "Rescue e-Loan", effectively improving the customer experience and service efficiency. The number of Internet channel customers of the Bank exceeded 820,000, increasing by 18.1% year on year; the WeChat bank transaction volume of the Bank ranked first among the urban commercial banks in the province; its replacement rate of online channel business was 94.3%, ranking third among the urban commercial banks in the province. Therefore, the Bank was rated as the "Outstanding Mobile Banking" in China's Financial and Economic List. The Bank had more than 230,000 registered direct banking customers, and the scale of the assets under its management exceeded RMB 5.3 billion, increasing by 130% and 44.8% compared with the same period last year respectively, ranking among the forefront of the urban commercial banks in China. Therefore, the Bank was awarded as the "Best Open Bank 2020". The Bank strengthened science and technology empowerment to support new progress in business development. The CBUS5.0 smart banking system was launched smoothly, and the centralized operation center, mobile exhibition platform and other projects provided effective support for the operation innovation of the Bank. With the help of the online supply chain platform of "Qi Bank e-Chain", it jointly launched the "Qi Bank e-Credit" product with a number of core enterprises, and successfully introduced block-chain technology to realize the first loan, and the development of its online supply chain business entered a new stage. The Bank introduced authoritative big data applications through multiple channels, and launched "e-Qi Scenario Loan" and other products, improving the approval efficiency and risk control level of credit business.

Fifthly, substantial results were achieved in risk prevention and control. The Bank steadily promoted its implementation project of the comprehensive risk management and new capital management measures, and made the credit risk internal evaluation system project launched smoothly, providing strong support for refined risk control. The Bank the Bank strengthened the risk prevention and control of credit granting. The Bank centralized the authority of credit approval, reduced the approval nodes, optimized the approval mode, and enhanced the quality and efficiency of credit business approval. The Bank revised and enabled the new version of credit contract, improving the efficiency in the use of contract texts. The Bank continuously standardized the loan audit, and achieved the prominent effect in the "last pass" for risk prevention of the loan center of each branch. The Bank optimized and adjusted the system control rules in the areas for the implementation of various services, and continuously strengthened the remote credit control ability. The Bank continued to strengthen risk prevention and control in key areas. The Bank strengthened account management, carried out unannounced inspection, and continued to strengthen counter operation risk control. The Bank adhered to the principle of priority to liquidity, scientifically allocated the asset-liability structure and continued to promote liquidity risk control; the Bank kept strengthening information security and effectively avoided the information technology risks brought by the wide application of Internet finance; the Bank gave full play to the advantage of the dispatched risk manager mechanism, strengthened market analysis and prediction, properly monitored investment targets, and enhanced the effectiveness of market risk prevention and control; the Bank steadily promoted the reform of the "Loan Prime Rate" mechanism by the People's Bank of China, and achieved a smooth and orderly transition. The Bank scientifically allocated the foreign exchange position, and did a good job in market risk early warning, effectively preventing the exchange rate risk. The Bank strictly monitored public opinions, increased positive publicity, actively dealt with complaints, and continued to strengthen the initiative of reputation risk prevention. The Bank conducted the collection and disposal of non-performing loans, and successfully completed the goal and task of tackling tough problems. The Bank strengthened organizational leadership, strengthened management and control measures, actively sought the support from local governments, and fully completed the three-year goal and task of risk mitigation assigned by Shandong Provincial CPC Committee and People's Government as well as China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission Shandong Office.

In 2021, the Bank will fully implement the spirit of the 19th CPC National Congress, the second, third and fourth plenary sessions of the 19th CPC Central Committee and the Central Economic Working Conference, adhere to the general principle of seeking progress while maintaining stability, base itself on the new development stage, implement the new development concept, get integrated into the new development pattern, adhere to the concept of "operating the Bank with distinctive characteristics, making the Bank survive with talents, empowering the Bank with science and technology, governing the Bank by compliance with regulations, invigorating the Bank with services, and leading the Bank with culture", set up the guidance of "improving quality and efficiency in development and striving for excellence in management", create the business development model of "putting inclusive retail business first, expanding corporate finance, upgrading e-banking business and making innovation in interbank investment banking", vigorously implement the "big retail strategy", "strategy of strengthening the Head Office" and "financial technology strategy", build a scientific "refined management system", "comprehensive marketing system" and "political advancement system", improve the fair and just human resource management system and the business assessment and incentive mechanism, promote transformation to be "refined, intelligent, intensified and light-weight", make a good start for "starting a new undertaking and scaling new heights", promote the Bank's high-quality sustainable development to a new level, and continue to strive for creating a modern commercial bank with "distinctive characteristics scientific management, strict internal control and strong competitiveness".

1、业务规模稳步增长。截至报告期末，本行集团口径资产总额1,501.38亿元，较年初增加182.87亿元，增幅13.87%；母公司法人口径资产总额1,393.08亿元，较年初增加148.46亿元，增幅11.93%；集团口径贷款总额952.80亿元，较年初增加138.91亿元，增幅17.07%；母公司法人口径贷款总额887.55亿元，较年初增加81.36亿元，增幅7.98%。集团口径负债总额1,367.06亿元，较年初增加179.61亿元，增幅15.13%；母公司法人口径负债总额1,263.42亿元，较年初增加146.45亿元，增幅13.11%；集团口径存款总额1,220.79亿元，较年初增加113.75亿元，增幅10.28%；母公司法人口径存款总额1,100.53亿元，较年初增加81.36亿元，增幅7.98%。

2、经营效益保持平稳。截至报告期末，集团口径实现税前利润7.69亿元，较同期减少0.19亿元，减幅2.42%；母公司法人口径实现税前利润7.40亿元，较同期增加0.18亿元，增幅2.45%；集团口径实

现归属母公司净利润5.60亿元，较同期减少0.33亿元，减幅5.64%；母公司法人口径实现净利润5.59亿元，较同期减少0.15亿元，减幅2.57%。集团口径成本收入比为46.49%，较同期上升2.28个百分点。其中，发生业务及管理费用12.19亿元，较同期上升0.52%；营业收入26.22亿元，较同期下降4.41%。母公司法人口径成本收入比为44.97%，较同期上升0.81个百分点。其中，发生业务及管理费用10.77亿元，较同期下降4.06%；营业收入23.96亿元，较同期下降5.80%。

3、改革转型扎实推进。报告期内，本行根据宏观经济金融形势及发展实际，有效贯彻落实中期发展规划，突破了制约发展的重大瓶颈，取得了实质性成效。一是转型改革焕发活力。本行在认真总结、深刻剖析全行短板差距的基础上，借鉴同业经验，结合自身实际，迈出了全方位改革的坚定步伐。针对改革发展对优秀人才的需求与现有人力资源支撑力不足的矛盾，一方面面向社会广纳人才，同时选拔行内优秀干部员工组建三级“人才库”，为今后人才梯队建设及选拔任用提供了有力保障；再一方面制定了科学合理的内退转岗政策，人力资源结构得到进一步优化。按照“强总行”思路，突出条线管控和前台营销，充实前台部门、强化中台部门、精简后台部门，为提升总行“管理、引领、支撑、服务”能力提供了体制保障。本着“引入竞争机制、提升决策效率”的原则，在淄博地区增设了一家分行级机构，合并了中心城区6家管辖支行，进一步缩短了管理半径、优化了网点设置、激发了内生活力。大力培育“履职尽责、尽职免责、严肃追责、全程覆盖”的“信贷文化”，着力塑造“立标、对标、达标”的“标杆文化”和“公开、公平、公正”的“用人文化”，持续倡树激励广大干部员工拼搏创业的“干事文化”和“执行文化”，积极为全员办实事、办好事，进一步增强了全员的归属感、凝聚力和向心力。二是结构调整更加科学。秉承“有组织、上规模、高层次”的营销理念，专项营销活动取得积极成果。相继与部分市属龙头企业达成全面战略合作，与国内部分优质企业签署战略合作协议，授信业务及客户结构持续优化。坚持“零售业务批发做”理念，做深做透供应链金融，全面完成了“两增两控”监管指标，获评“2020年卓越竞争力供应链金融银行”；信用卡有效持卡量、授信额度、交易金额均稳中有升，获评“年度信用卡业务发展奖”等荣誉称号。持续扩大债券交易，有效提升自营资金收益水平，再获“全国银行间本币市场最佳进步奖”。全年累计发行理财产品306期、募集资金343亿元，实现中间业务收入同比增长约140%。牢牢把握“存款立行、负债先行”理念，充分发挥产品优势，顺利运营多家助农点，多渠道开展综合营销，大力推动系统性存款准入及大客户营销，负债基础进一步夯实。

4、创新发展持续深化。一是落实各项政策，小微金融服务实现新拓展。积极响应国家及监管部门号召，加大对防疫企业和遇困小微企业、个体工商户的支持力度，办理无还本续贷1.32亿元，发放普惠小微信用贷款8.72亿元，办理延期还本付息贷款18.77亿元；发放疫情专用支小再贷款超10亿元，居全市首位；发放“人才贷”2.05亿元，居全省城商行首位；发放“纾困贷”1.54亿元，占全市总放款量的90%以上，发放“创业担保贷”3.86亿元，两项产品惠及全市6000余户小微企业，金融辅导工作被省政府主管部门评为省级“优秀”单位。二是丰富服务功能，网络金融服务跃升新层次。创新推出“e齐税易贷”“纾困e贷”等线上贷款产品，有效提升了客户体验及服务效率。互联网渠道客户数量突破82万户，同比增长18.1%，微信银行交易量居全省城商行首位，网络渠道业务替代率94.3%，居全省城商行第三位，获评中国财经风云榜“杰出手机银行”。直销银行注册客户超过23万户，管理资产规模突破53亿元，较上年同期分别增长130%和44.8%，位居全国城商行前列，获评“2020年度最佳开放银行”。三

是强化科技赋能，支撑业务发展取得新进步。CBUS5.0智慧银行系统顺利上线运行，集中作业中心、移动展业平台等项目为运营创新提供了有效支撑。借助“齐银e链”在线供应链平台，与多家核心企业联合推出“齐银e信”产品，并成功引入区块链技术实现首笔放款，线上供应链业务发展迈入新阶段。多渠道引入权威大数据应用，推出“e齐场景贷”等产品，提升了授信业务审批效率及风控水平。

5、风险防控科学有效。报告期内，全面风险管理暨新资本管理办法实施项目稳步推进，信用风险内评体系项目顺利上线运行，风险精细化管理水平不断提升。一是运用历次检查“回头看”成果，坚持问题导向，狠抓整改落实。扎实开展“行业规范建设深化年”活动，统筹推进“四项规范”建设及重点工作落实，促进合规管理水平实现新提升。二是强化授信风险防控，集中上收了授信审批权限，减少审批节点，优化审批模式，增强了授信业务审批质效及合同文本使用效率，各分行放款中心风险防范“最后一道关口”效果显现，异地授信管控能力持续加强。三是重点领域风险防控持续加力，加强账户管理，柜面操作风险管控不断强化；坚持流动性优先原则，科学配置资产负债结构，流动性风险管控水平持续提升；信息安全常抓不懈，有效防范了互联网金融广泛应用带来的信息科技风险；发挥派驻风险经理机制优势，加强市场分析预判，做好投资标的风险监测，提升了市场风险防控成效；严密监测舆情，加大正面宣传，积极应对处理信访事件，声誉风险防范的主动性持续增强。截至报告期末，本行集团口径五级分类不良贷款率1.48%，较年初下降0.32个百分点；拨备覆盖率133.09%，拨贷比1.97%。

## 二、主要业务运作情况

1、个人存款情况：截至报告期末，本行集团口径本外币个人存款余额468.08亿元，比年初增加110.55亿元，增幅30.92%，在各项存款中占比38.34%，比年初上升6.04个百分点。

2、个人贷款情况：截至报告期末，本行集团口径本外币个人贷款余额163.28亿元，比年初增加35.18亿元，增幅27.46%，在各项贷款中占比17.14%，比年初上升1.40个百分点。

3、对公存款情况：截至报告期末，本行集团口径本外币对公存款余额752.71亿元，比年初增加3.20亿元，增幅0.43%，在各项存款中占比61.66%，比年初下降6.04个百分点。

4、对公贷款情况：截至报告期末，本行集团口径本外币对公贷款余额789.52亿元，比年初增加103.73亿元，增幅15.13%，在各项贷款中占比82.86%，比年初下降1.40个百分点。

## 1. The business grew steadily.

By the end of the reporting period, the total amount of assets at the Bank's Group level was RMB 150.138 billion, up by RMB 18.287 billion or 13.87% over the beginning of the year; the total amount of assets at the parent company's legal person level was RMB 139.308 billion, up by RMB 14.846 billion or 11.93% over the beginning of the year; the total amount of loans at the Group level was RMB 95.280 billion, up by RMB 13.891 billion or 17.07% over the beginning of the year; the total amount of loans at the parent company's legal person level was RMB 88.755 billion, up by RMB 8.136 billion or 7.98% over the beginning of the year. The total amount of liabilities at the Group level was RMB 136.706 billion, up by RMB 17.961 billion or 15.13% over the beginning of the year; the total amount of liabilities at the parent company's legal person level was RMB 126.342 billion, up by RMB 14.645 billion or 13.11% over the beginning of the year; the total amount of deposits at the Group level was RMB 122.079 billion, up by RMB 11.375 billion or 10.28% over the beginning of the year; the total amount of deposits at the parent company's

legal person level was RMB 110.053 billion, up by RMB 8.136 billion or 7.98% over the beginning of the year.

## 2. The operating benefits remained stable.

By the end of the reporting period, the pretax profit at the Group level was RMB 769 million, down by RMB 19 million or 2.42% over the same period; the pretax profit at the parent company's legal person level was RMB 740 million, up by RMB 18 million or 2.45% over the same period; the net profit attributable to the parent company at the Group level was RMB 560 million, down by RMB 33 million or 5.64% over the same period; the net profit at the parent company's legal person level was RMB 559 million, down by RMB 15 million or 2.57% over the same period. The cost-income ratio at the Group level was 46.49%, up by 2.28 percentage points over the same period, of which there were business and management expenses incurred of RMB 1.219 billion, up by 0.52% over the same period; the operating income of RMB 2.622 billion, down by 4.41% over the same period. The cost-to-income ratio at the parent company's legal person level was 44.97%, up by 0.81 percentage points over the same period, of which there were business and management expenses incurred of RMB 1.077 billion, down by 4.06% over the same period; the operating income of RMB 2.396 billion, down by 5.80% over the same period.

## 3. Solid progress was made in reform and transformation.

During the reporting period, according to the macroeconomic and financial situation and the actual development situation, the Bank effectively implemented the medium-term development plan, broke through the major bottleneck restricting its development, and achieved substantial results. Firstly, the transformation and reform were full of vitality. By earnestly summarizing and deeply analyzing the gap from other banks and its shortcomings, the Bank drew on the experience of the peer banks and took firm steps in all-round reform on the basis of its own actual conditions. In view of the contradiction between the demand for outstanding talents in reform and development and the lack of existing human resources, on the one hand, the Bank widely attracted talents from society, and selected outstanding officers and employees internally to form a three-level "talent pool", providing a strong guarantee for the construction, selection and appointment of talent echelon in the future; on the other hand, the Bank established a scientific and reasonable policy of internal withdrawal and job transfer, further optimizing the HR structure. According to the idea of "strengthening the Head Office", the Bank highlighted the line control and front-office marketing, enriched the front-office department, strengthened the middle-office department, and streamlined the back-office department, providing an institutional guarantee for improving the "management, guidance, support and service" ability of the Head Office. Under the principle of "introducing competition mechanism and improving decision efficiency", the Bank established a branch-level institution in Zibo and merged 6 sub-branches in the downtown of the city, further shortening the management radius, optimizing the setup of outlets and stimulating the internal living force. The Bank vigorously cultivated the "credit culture" of "dedicated to work, responsible for work, strict in accountability and full coverage", focused on shaping the "benchmarking culture" of "establishing standards, checking standards and achieving standards" and the "employment culture" of "open, fair and impartial", continued to promote the "culture of diligence" and the "culture of execution" encouraging officers and employees to work hard with entrepreneurship, actively did practical work and provided good benefits for the whole staff, so as to further enhance their sense of belonging, cohesion and centripetal force. Secondly, the structural adjustment was reasonable. The Bank adhered to the marketing idea of "organized, large-scale and high-level", so the special marketing activities achieved positive results. The Bank reached comprehensive strategic cooperation with some leading municipal enterprises, signed strategic cooperation agreements with some high-quality domestic enterprises, and continuously optimized the credit business and customer structure. Adhering to the idea of "running retail business as wholesale business", the Bank deeply and thoroughly enhanced its supply chain finance, fully completed the regulatory indicators of "two increases and two controls", and therefore was awarded the "Excellent Competitive Supply Chain Financial Bank 2020". The number of valid credit cards, credit line and transaction amount all increased steadily, and thereby the Bank won the "Annual Credit Card Business Development Award" and other honorary titles. The Bank continued to expand bond transactions, effectively improved the income level of self-operated funds, and was honored with the "Best Progress Award in the National Inter-bank Currency Market" again. Throughout the year, the Bank issued 306 wealth management products and raised funds of RMB

34.3 billion, realizing a year-on-year growth of intermediate business revenues by about 140%. The Bank firmly upheld the idea of "deposit foremost, liability first", gave full play to its product advantages, smoothly operated a number of agricultural assistance sites, carried out comprehensive marketing through multiple channels, vigorously promoted systematic deposit access and marketing of major customers, and further consolidated its liability foundation.

## 4. The innovative development continued to deepen.

Firstly, the Bank implemented various policies and achieved new expansion in small and micro financial services. The Bank actively responded to the call of the state and regulatory authorities, enhancing the support for epidemic prevention enterprises and small and micro enterprises in trouble and privately or individually-owned businesses. It handled RMB 132 million renewed loans without repaying principal, issued RMB 872 million small and micro inclusive credit loans, and handled RMB 1.877 billion loans extending the repayment of principal and interest. The Bank issued more than RMB 1 billion small reloans for epidemic prevention and control purpose, ranking first in the city. The Bank issued RMB 205 million "talent loans", ranking first in the province's urban commercial banks. The Bank issued RMB 154 million "rescue loans", accounting for more than 90% of the total loans of the city, and issued RMB 386 million "entrepreneurship guaranteed loans". The two products benefited more than 6,000 small and micro enterprises in the city. Due to its financial guidance, the Bank was rated as the "Provincial Excellent Entity" by the competent authority of the provincial government. Secondly, the Bank enriched its service functions, and upgraded its online financial services. The Bank innovatively launched online loan products such as "e-Qi Tax and Easy Loan" and "Rescue e-Loan", effectively improving the customer experience and service efficiency. The number of Internet channel customers of the Bank exceeded 820,000, increasing by 18.1% year on year; the WeChat bank transaction volume of the Bank ranked first among the urban commercial banks in the province; its replacement rate of online channel business was 94.3%, ranking third among the urban commercial banks in the province. Therefore, the Bank was rated as the "Outstanding Mobile Banking" in China's Financial and Economic List. The Bank had more than 230,000 registered direct banking customers, and the scale of the assets under its management exceeded RMB 5.3 billion, increasing by 130% and 44.8% compared with the same period last year respectively, ranking among the forefront of the urban commercial banks in China. Therefore, the Bank was awarded as the "Best Open Bank 2020". Thirdly, the Bank strengthened science and technology empowerment to support new progress in business development. The CBUS5.0 smart banking system was launched smoothly, and the centralized operation center, mobile exhibition platform and other projects provided effective support for the operation innovation of the Bank. With the help of the online supply chain platform of "Qi Bank e-Chain", it jointly launched the "Qi Bank e-Credit" product with a number of core enterprises, and successfully introduced block-chain technology to realize the first loan, and the development of its online supply chain business entered a new stage. The Bank introduced authoritative big data applications through multiple channels, and launched "e-Qi Scenario Loan" and other products, improving the approval efficiency and risk control level of credit business.

## 5. The risk prevention and control of the Bank was scientific and effective.

During the reporting period, the projects implemented for the comprehensive risk management and new capital management measures were advanced steadily, the credit risk evaluation system project was launched smoothly, and the level of refined risk management was continuously improved. Firstly, the Bank made full use of the previous "look back" inspection results, kept problem-oriented, and paid close attention to the rectification and implementation. The Bank steadily carried out the campaign of "Year of Deepening the Construction of Industry Standards", coordinated the construction of "Four Standards" and the implementation of key work, and promoted the new improvement of compliance management. Secondly, the Bank strengthened the risk prevention and control of credit granting, centralized credit approval authority, reduced the approval nodes, optimized the approval mode, and enhanced the quality and efficiency of credit business approval and the use efficiency of contract text. The effect of the "last pass" of risk prevention of all the branches appeared, and the control ability of remote credit granting was continuously strengthened. Thirdly, the Bank continued to strengthen risk prevention and control in key areas, strengthen account management, and strengthen counter operation risk control; the Bank adhered to the principle of priority to liquidity, scientifically allocated the asset-liability structure and continued to promote

the liquidity risk control; the Bank kept strengthening information security and effectively avoided the information technology risks brought by the wide application of Internet finance; the Bank gave full play to the advantage of the dispatched risk manager mechanism, strengthened market analysis and prediction, properly monitored investment targets, and enhanced the effectiveness of market risk prevention and control; the Bank strictly monitored public opinions, increased positive publicity, actively dealt with complaints, and continued to strengthen the initiative of reputation risk prevention. By the end of the reporting period, the non-performing loan ratio of the five-level classification at the Bank's Group level was 1.48%, down by 0.32 percentage points over the beginning of the year; the provision coverage ratio was 133.09%, and the provision-to-loan ratio was 1.97%.

## II. Operation Situation of Main Business

1. Personal Deposits: By the end of the reporting period, the Bank's balance of personal deposits in RMB and foreign currencies was RMB 46.808 billion, up by RMB 11.055 billion or 30.92% over the beginning of the year, accounting for 38.34% in various deposits and up by 6.04 percentage points over the beginning of the year.

2. Personal Loans: By the end of the reporting period, the Bank's balance of personal loans in RMB and foreign currencies was RMB 16.328 billion, up by RMB 3.518 billion or 27.46% over the beginning of the year, accounting for 17.14% in various loans and up by 1.40 percentage points over the beginning of the year.

3. Corporate Deposits: By the end of the reporting period, the Bank's balance of corporate deposits in RMB and foreign currencies was RMB 75.271 billion, up by RMB 320 million or 0.43% over the beginning of the year, accounting for 61.66% in various deposits and down by 6.04 percentage points over the beginning of the year.

4. Corporate Loans: By the end of the reporting period, the Bank's balance of corporate loans in RMB and foreign currencies was RMB 78.952 billion, up by RMB 10.373 billion or 15.13% over the beginning of the year, accounting for 82.86% in various loans and down by 1.40 percentage points over the beginning of the year.

### 2、股权变更情况

报告期内，本行股东青岛融海国投资产管理有限公司根据山东银保监局《关于核准青岛融海国投资产管理有限公司股东资格的批复》（鲁银保监准〔2019〕1007号）受让股份17,106.78万股。受让后，青岛融海国投资产管理有限公司持有本行27.973.45万股，持股比例为7.19%。

## (三) 股本变动情况

报告期内，本行股本未发生变化。报告期末，本行注册资本3,887,921,566元，股本总额3,887,921,566股。

## 二、年内召开股东大会情况

（一）2020年4月30日，本行2019年度股东大会在总行二楼群英厅召开，出席本次会议的股东和股东代表44名，代表有表决权股份数302,911万股，占总股本的78%，符合《中华人民共和国公司法》和本行《公司章程》的有关规定。董事长杲传勇先生主持了会议。会议经山东鲁杰律师事务所律师现场见证。会议经过有效表决，一致通过如下决议：

1. 审议通过了《第七届董事会2019年度工作报告》；

2. 审议通过了《第七届监事会2019年度工作报告》；

3. 审议通过了《关于2019年度财务计划执行情况和2020年度财务预算草案的报告》；

5. 审议通过了《监事会关于2019年度董事及高级管理层成员履职评价情况的报告》；

6. 审议通过了《监事会关于2019年度监事履职评价情况的报告》。

大会还通报了《2019年度前十大股东持股情况》、《2019年度关联方交易情况》、《2019年度前十大授信集团客户情况》。

## （三）董事会工作情况

报告期内，董事会认真研究执行国家宏观经济政策，严格贯彻落实监管部门要求，不断加强董事会履职能力建设，本行经营管理和创新发展跃上了新台阶。一是充分保障股东权益，股东大会职能得到有效发挥。二是持续提升履职能力和决策水平，严格按照《公司章程》及议事规则，全面落实党委会研究审议的前置程序要求，有效突出党组织在公司治理结构中的领导核心地位。报告期内组织召开了四次例会、八次临时会议，对董事会职权范围内的业务报告和议案进行了讨论和审议，谨慎、认真、勤勉地履行了决策职责；制定印发了《齐商银行股份有限公司数据治理管理政策》等规章制度，公司治理主体的职责边界和决策程序更加清晰，治理体系更加协调完善。增补三位股东董事，调增董事会下设专门委员会中的独立董事数量，董事会成员结构持续改善。有效提升股权管理水平，持续坚持“长期稳定、透明诚信、公平合理”原则，主动防范有关风险。三是扎实推进战略转型和结构调整，经营业绩实现稳步增长。四是不断强化全面风险管理，风险管理及内控机制建设得到进一步完善。五是持续坚持创新引领，核心竞争力得到有效提升。六是不断深化资本管理，严格落实《齐商银行股份有限公司2019-2021年资本管理规划》，有效加强全行资本管理，满足业务发展和风险管理需要；持续拓宽外源性资本补充渠道，启动无固定期限资

本债券发行申请工作，资本实力及效率进一步增强。七是不断规范信息披露渠道，对外信息披露透明度及规范性持续提高。

## （三）监事会工作情况

报告期内，监事会能够认真贯彻《商业银行公司治理指引》《商业银行监事会工作指引》等监管法规，充分发挥监事会的监督职能，协调运用多种监督手段，按照依法合规、客观公正、科学有效的原则，积极开展履职监督、财务监督、内控监督、风险管理监督，监督理念不断深化，监督能力不断提高，较好地履行了职责，维护了本行、股东、存款人的合法权益。一是组织召开了四次监事会例会，审议通过了32项议案及报告。按时召开监事会监督委员会、提名委员会会议，研究审议有关应议事项。组织监事列席董事会例会，听取议案及报告，并对法定监督议案或报告发表了意见；组织列席了股东大会，对审议决策有效监督，保证了广大股东的合法权益，较好地行使了监事会和监事的知情权、监督权。二是积极参与董事会、高级管理层的经营管理活动，并对重大事项、重大决策进行有效监督；组织开展巡视监督活动，对信贷资产质量、信用风险管控、洗钱及恐怖融资风险管控等事项发表专业意见，有效提升监事会监督制衡效率及水平。三是依法合规完成外部监事补充及职工监事的增选工作，高层次外部监事为本行准确把握宏观经济形势和政策方向，独立判断、分析、决策重要事项，有效识别经营风险提供了专业化高水平的意见建议，切实维护了广大股东及利益相关者的权益，为本行发展发挥了应有的监督作用。

## （四）外部监事工作情况

## 五、高级管理层人员构成及基本情况

（一）本行总行高级管理层人员共有12人。其中：董事长1人，行长1人，副行长3人，行长助理2人，董事会秘书1人，内审负责人1人，财务负责人1人，首席信息官1人，风险总监1人。

（二）分支行主要管理人员共有153人，其中：分行（含淄博支行）行长8人，分行（含淄博支行）副行长、行长助理23人；管辖支行行长46人，管辖支行副行长、行长助理76人。

上述人员均符合监管部门规定的任职资格条件，并按要求通过了监管部门的任职资格核准或备案。

## 六、部门和分支机构设置情况

本行董事会下设战略规划委员会、关联交易控制委员会、风险管理委员会、薪酬考核及提名委员会、审计委员会、执行委员会、消费者权益保护委员会。监事会下设提名委员会、监督委员会。总行下设23个部室及西安分行等124家分支行。

## 七、年度薪酬情况

2020年度本行董事会、监事会及高级管理层人员履职情况良好，有效完成全年任务目标。本行董事、监事和高级管理人员在本行领取薪酬的共33人，税前总计1,131万元。其中：本行高级管理人员2020年度发放薪酬税前共计815万元（含市管干部2019年度薪酬补差和2017-2018年度任期激励的50%），包括年度风险基金56万元，根据公司风险基金管理办法，该风险基金延后三年考核发放。

本行高级管理人员的薪酬依据考核办法，按照季度考核结果核算兑现，其中市管干部薪酬按照市属国有企业负责人薪酬政策执行。独立董事、非执行董事、外部监事、股东监事的津贴根据尽职考核情况兑现。

## II. Situation of Shareholders' General Meetings Held in the Year

(I) The 2019 Annual General Meeting of shareholders of the Bank was held in Qunying Hall, 2/F, Head Office, on April 30, 2020. A total of 44 shareholders and their representatives attended the meeting, representing 3,029,110,000 shares with the voting right and accounting for 78% of the Bank's shares. This meeting was convened in conformity with the relevant provisions of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and relevant provisions of the Bank's Articles of Association. The Chairman Gao Chuanyong presided over the meeting. The lawyers of Shandong Lujie Law Office conducted the spot witness as to the meeting. The meeting unanimously adopted the following resolutions after effective voting:

1. Deliberated and adopted the 2019 Annual Work Report of the Seventh Board of Directors;

2. Deliberated and adopted the 2019 Annual Work Report of the Seventh Board of Supervisors;

3. Deliberated and adopted the Report on the Implementation of 2019 Annual Financial Plan and 2020 Annual Financial Budget Draft;

4. Deliberated and adopted the Proposal on the Profit Distribution Plan in 2019;

5. Deliberated and adopted the Report of the Board of Supervisors on Performance Evaluation of Directors and Senior Executives in 2018;

6. Deliberated and adopted the Report of the Board of Supervisors on Performance Evaluation of Supervisors in 2019.

The meeting also announced 2019 Annual Shareholdings of Top Ten Shareholders, 2019 Annual Transactions of Affiliated Parties, and 2019 Annual Top Ten Credit Group Customers.

(II) The First Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders of QISHANG BANK CO., LTD. in 2020 was held in Qinying Hall, 2/F, QISHANG BANK Head Office, on July 31, 2020. A number of 38 shareholders and their representatives attended the meeting, representing 3,005,450,000 shares with the voting right and accounting for 77% of the Bank's shares. This meeting was convened in conformity with the relevant provisions of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and the Bank's Articles of Association. The Chairman Gao Chuanyong presided over the meeting. The lawyers of Shandong Lujie Law Office conducted the spot witness as to the meeting. The meeting unanimously adopted the following resolutions after effective voting:

1. Deliberated and adopted the Proposal on the Resignment of Directors;

2. Deliberated and adopted the Proposal on the Resignment of Staff Supervisors;

3. Deliberated and adopted the Proposal on the Election of Directors;

4. Deliberated and adopted the Proposal on the Election of Supervisors.

The Second Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders of QISHANG BANK CO., LTD. in 2020 was held in Qinying Hall, 2/F, QISHANG BANK Head Office, on September 30, 2020. A number of 35 shareholders and their representatives attended the meeting, representing 2,766,970,000 shares with the voting right and accounting for 71% of the Bank's shares. This meeting was convened in conformity with the relevant provisions of the Company Law of the People's Republic of China and the Bank's Articles of Association. The lawyers of Shandong Lujie Law Office conducted the spot witness as to the meeting. The meeting unanimously adopted the following resolutions after effective voting:

2. Deliberated and adopted the Proposal on the Resignment of Directors;

1. Deliberated and adopted the Proposal on the Issuance of Unfixed Term Capital Bonds;

3. Deliberated and adopted the Proposal on the Election of Directors.

#### (II) Special committees under the Board of Directors

The Board of Directors has set up the Strategic Planning Committee, Related Transaction Control Committee, Risk Management Committee, Remuneration Assessment & Nomination Committee, Auditing Committee, Executive Committee and Consumer Rights Protection Committee with the sound rules of procedure. A total of 43 meetings were convened during the reporting period. The attendance rate of various committee members met the regulatory requirements, which supported the Board of Directors to play its role of decision-making fully and effectively.

##### (III) Work of the Board of Directors

During the reporting period, the Board of Directors researched and implemented the national macroeconomic policy earnestly, carried out the regulatory requirements of supervision departments strictly, and strengthened the performance capacity building of the Board of Directors constantly. The Bank reached a new stage in business management and innovative development. Firstly, the Bank fully ensured the shareholders' equity and enabled the functions of the shareholders' meetings to play an effective role. Secondly, the Bank continued to improve its ability to perform its duties and decision-making level, fully implemented the requirements of pre-procedures studied and deliberated by CPC Committee, and effectively highlighted the core leadership position of the Party organization in the corporate governance structure, strictly in accordance with the Articles of Association and rules of procedure. During the reporting period, the Bank organized four regular meetings and eight interim meetings to discuss and deliberate the business reports and proposals within the scope of the functions and powers of the Board of Directors, and performed the decision-making duties carefully, conscientiously and diligently. The Bank formulated and issued the rules and regulations such as the Data Governance Management Policy of QISHANG BANK CO., LTD. so that the responsibility boundaries and decision-making procedures of the Bank as a corporate governance subject were clearer, and the governance system was more coordinated and perfect. The Bank supplemented tree shareholder directors, increased the number of independent Directors in the special committees under the Board of Directors so that the member structure of the Board of Directors continued to be improved. The Bank effectively improved the level of equity management, continued to adhere to the principles of "long-term stability, transparency, integrity, fairness and rationality," and took the initiative to prevent relevant risks. Thirdly, the Bank solidly pushed forward the strategic transformation and structural adjustment, so

as to achieve the steady growth of operating results. Fourthly, the Bank constantly strengthened the comprehensive risk management and further improved the construction of risk management and the internal control mechanism. Fifthly, the Bank constantly insisted on innovation-driven development to effectively improve its core competitiveness. Sixthly, the Bank continued to deepen capital management, strictly implemented the 2019-2021 Capital Management Plan of QISHANG BANK CO., LTD., and effectively strengthened the capital management of the whole bank, meeting the needs of business development and risk management; the Bank continued to expand the channels for exogenous capital, and launched the application for the issuance of fixed-term capital bonds, further enhancing its capital strength and efficiency. Seventhly, the Bank constantly standardized the information disclosure channel to improve the transparency and standardization of external information disclosure.

##### (II) Special committees under the Board of Supervisors

The Board of Supervisors set up the Supervision Committee and the Nomination Committee with sound rules of procedure. Meetings were convened for 8 times during the reporting period. The attendance rate of the members was in line with the regulatory requirements, and the role of the Board of Supervisors was fully and effectively developed.

##### (III) Work of the Board of Supervisors

During the reporting period, the Board of Supervisors earnestly implemented the Guidelines for the Governance of Commercial Banks, the Guidelines for the Work of the Board of Supervisors of Commercial Banks and other applicable supervision laws and regulations, gave full play to the supervision function of the Board of Supervisors, coordinated and made full use of various supervision means, actively carried out performance supervision, financial supervision, internal control supervision, risk management supervision under the principles of legality and compliance, objectiveness and fairness, scientificity and efficiency, and continued to deepen its supervision philosophy and improve its supervision ability so that the supervisors could better perform their duties, and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the Bank, its shareholders and depositors. Firstly, the Bank organized four regular meetings of the Board of Supervisors, and deliberated and adopted 32 proposals and reports. The Bank held the meetings of the Supervision Committee and the Nomination Committee of the Board of Supervisors on schedule, and studied and deliberated the relevant matters on question. The Bank organized the supervisors to attend the regular meetings of the Board of Directors as non-voting delegates, listening to the proposals and reports, and expressing their opinions on the legal supervision proposals or reports; the Bank organized the supervisors to attend the general meeting of shareholders as non-voting delegates, effectively supervising the deliberations and decisions of the general meeting of shareholders, ensuring the legitimate rights and interests of the majority of shareholders, and better exercising the right to know and supervision of the Board of Supervisors and supervisors. Secondly, the Bank actively participated in the operation and management activities of the Board of Directors and the Senior Management, and effectively supervised major matters and major decisions; the Bank organized and carried out inspection and supervision activities, expressed professional opinions on credit asset quality, credit risk control, money laundering and terrorist financing risk control, effectively enhancing the efficiency and level of checks and balances of the Board of Supervisors. Thirdly, the Bank completed the supplement of External Supervisors and the additional selection of Staff Supervisors according to law. The high-level External Supervisors provided professional and high-level opinions and suggestions for the Bank, independently judged, analyzed and decided important matters, effectively identified business risks and provided professional high-level suggestions and comments, effectively safeguarding the rights and interests of shareholders and stakeholders, and playing a due supervisory role in the development of the Bank.

##### (IV) Work of External Supervisors


<table border=1 style='margin: auto; word-wrap: break-word;'><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Name of External Supervisor</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Number of the meetings of the Board of Supervisors this year</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Number of actual attendance</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Duan Fuxing</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>2</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>2</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Meng Hong</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>4</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>4</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Zhang Xueyong</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>2</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>2</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>Zhang Zongxin</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>2</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>2</td></tr></table>

During the reporting period, four External Supervisors attended the meetings of the Board of Supervisors in compliance with laws and regulations, gave full play to their expertise in financial research, analyzed and read financial statements in a timely manner, paid attention to the Bank's management status, expressed independent opinions and brought forward improvement suggestions for the strategic innovation, structural adjustment, operational risk control, planning management, the execution of the resolutions of the Board of Supervisors, etc. in due course, and performed their independent supervision duties.

## V. Composition and Basic Information of Senior Management

(I) The Senior Management of the Bank's Head Office has a total of 12 members, including: 1 Chairman of the Board of Directors, 1 President of the Bank, 3 Deputy Presidents of the Bank, 2 President Assistants of the Bank, 1 Secretary to the Board of Directors, 1 Internal Control Manager, 1 Financial Manager, 1 Chief Information Officer and 1 Risk Director.

(II) The main management of the branches and sub-branches has a total of 153 members, including: 8 Presidents of Branches (including Zibo Sub-branch), 23 Deputy Presidents and President Assistants of Branches (including Zibo Sub-branch); 46 Presidents of Sub-branches and 76 Deputy Presidents and President Assistants of Sub-branches.

The above personnel are all in line with the qualifications stipulated by regulatory authorities, and have passed the qualification examination or filing of regulatory authorities as required.

## VI. Setup of Departments and Branch Organizations

The Board of Directors of the Bank has set up the Strategic Planning Committee, Related Transaction Control Committee, Risk Management Committee, Remuneration Assessment & Nomination Committee, Auditing Committee, Executive Committee and Consumer Rights Protection Committee. The Board of Supervisors has set up the Nomination Committee and Supervision Committee. The Head Office of the Bank consists of 23 departments or offices, and 124 branches and sub-branches, i.e., Xi'an Branch, and so forth.

## VII. Annual Remunerations

In 2020, the Board of Directors, the Board of Supervisor and senior executives well performed their duties and effectively fulfilled the full-year targets. A total of 33 directors, supervisors and senior executives received remunerations amounting to pre-tax RMB 11.31 million from the Bank. Among them: a total of RMB 8.15 million was paid as the pre-tax remuneration of the senior executives in 2020 (including added performance salary in 2019 and 50% of the term incentive in 2017-2018 of the city-level officers), including RMB 560,000 for the annual risk fund, which will be paid based on appraisal results by three-year delay according to the Management Measures for the Corporate Risk Fund.

The remuneration of the senior executives of the Bank will be calculated and paid based on the quarterly assessment results according to the assessment methods, and that of the city-level officers shall be executed according to the remuneration policy for heads of municipal state-owned enterprises. The allowances for the Independent Directors, Non-executive Directors, External Supervisors, and Shareholder Supervisors shall be paid in accordance with the appraisal results in the due diligence.

各类风险和风险管理策略

Various Risks and Risk Management Strategy

# 第四部分·各类风险和风险管理策略

### 一、风险种类及形式

本行在经营中主要面临以下风险：信用风险、市场风险、操作风险、流动性风险等。本行积极采取各种行之有效的措施，努力防范和化解上述风险。

## 二、风险管理策略

本行董事会及其下设风险管理委员会，高级管理层及其下设风险管理委员会，负责本行风险管理及控制。通过持续统筹推进全面风险管理体系项目建设，在各类风险管理和内部控制方面建立了符合现代银行监管要求的框架体系。各部门根据职责分工具体负责本行信用风险、市场风险、操作风险、流动性风险等风险的管理和控制。

### （一）信用风险管理对策

本行坚持以服务实体经济发展为基础，以有效防范授信风险为底线，不断完善授信体制机制建设，持续优化授权管理模式和信贷资产结构，集中上收了授信审批权限，减少审批节点，优化审批模式，多措并举强化授信风险防控，授信管理制度和管理机制不断完善，风险源头和重点领域风险管控更加严密，不良贷款处置工作扎实推进，授信业务实现科学稳健、持续向好发展。本行将大额风险暴露管理纳入全面风险管理体系，计量并动态监测大额风险暴露变动，有效管控客户集中度风险。截至报告期末，本行达到大额风险暴露标准的非同业单一客户、非同业关联客户、同业单一客户、同业集团客户均符合监管要求。本行积极转变经营方式，认真贯彻绿色信贷政策，不断加大绿色金融创新和对节能环保、循环经济、低碳经济等绿色经济领域的信贷投放力度，取得了良好的经济效益和社会效益。

### （二）流动性风险管理对策

本行持续保持稳健的流动性风险管理策略，重视流动性指标的合规管理，实行重点流动性指标月度管理机制，提前规划业务总量和结构，预测、分析对流动性指标的影响，主动调整业务策略。同时不断提高资产负债管理能力，拓展资金来源渠道，确保负债总量适度、来源稳定、结构多元，提前做好备付准备和融资安排，增加优质流动性资产储备，加固应对外部冲击的“安全垫”。2020年流动性风险指标总体控制在合理范围内，主要流动性监管指标符合要求。

### （三）市场风险管理对策

本行持续优化市场风险监测报告机制，通过派驻风险经理定期开展业务风险分析，加强市场风险中台控制，持续加强对金融市场等相关业务的风险监测。根据市场情况制定风险限额指标并定期监测指标使

用情况、及时报告异常情况。按照监管要求建立合理的市场风险压力测试机制，不断完善压力测试情景，提高市场风险计量水平。目前建立了包括交易限额、止损限额以及风险限额在内的限额结构体系以实施对市场风险的识别、监测和控制。本行通过调整资产和负债的期限、设定市场风险限额等手段来管理利率风险，通过优化外汇资产与负债的结构组合，规避汇率风险。采用缺口分析、久期分析及利率风险敏感度分析等办法来监控管理资产、负债组合的整体利率风险，同时引入债券组合收益、市值评估、久期等系列风险指标对债券业务风险进行评估。

### （四）操作风险管理对策

本行依托内控合规与操作风险管理系统，在梳理优化业务和管理活动流程的基础上，进一步识别风险点和控制点并开展操作风险与控制自我评估工作，持续收集、监测操作风险关键指标，推进操作风险管理精细化。充分利用线上、线下资源，对柜员、客户经理、理财经理等重点岗位人员进行培训，持续提升员工业务水平，努力营造规范操作的氛围。推动信息系统自动化建设，积极升级运营系统，规范业务操作，在提升效率的同时减少误操作带来的操作风险。

### （五）信息科技风险管理对策

本行扎实践行“科技强行”理念，结合业务发展战略，积极研究金融科技及服务变革，切实增强科技赋能的使命感，加速推进数字化转型，引领全行信息科技发展。一是积极探索分布式微服务架构转型，提高系统功能高并发、弹性伸缩和服务共享能力，敏捷开发快速推进信息系统建设。二是以大数据智能化建设为抓手，积极推进数据治理和应用，建立健全数据标准和技术架构，强化场景应用分析能力，充分挖掘数据价值。三是严格落实网络安全责任，细化网络安全等级保护和关键信息基础设施保护措施，持续开展渗透测试、网络安全评估，组织信息科技全面审计和信息科技外包专项审计。截至报告期末，未发生重大网络安全事件。四是业务连续性体系不断完善，开展业务影响分析，组织实战化业务连续性演练，充分验证应急预案的合理性和有效性。

### （六）声誉风险管理对策

本行持续将声誉风险防控管理作为高质安全运营的重要环节，通过严格贯彻落实监管要求，认真执行工作规章制度，加强媒体合作与正面宣传，持续加大舆情监测、风险排查及管理工作力度，针对重要节点和敏感事件提前谋划、提早应对，扩大声誉风险防范工作培训范围，提升全行声誉风险事件应对能力和红线意识等各项工作措施，整体声誉风险处于低风险可控状态。报告期内，本行共受理各类投诉、求助57起，经过调查分析11起为有效投诉件，投诉类别主要为业务办理、服务、信用卡类，投诉地区主要在淄博市辖内。收到客户反映问题及投诉后，能够有效按流程处理，并及时与客户沟通，投诉事件处理完结率100%。截至报告期末，本行未发生重大声誉风险事件，持续保持安全运营。

### （七）合规风险管理对策

本行坚持“合规是发展的基石”“合规创造价值”理念，组织开展了“行业规范建设深化年”活动，

本行持续加强洗钱和恐怖融资风险管控，对洗钱和恐怖融资风险进行持续识别、审慎评估、有效控制及全程管理。通过健全洗钱和恐怖融资风险管理体系，完善风险管理架构，深化内控制度建设，完善反洗钱系统功能，加强反洗钱业务人员培训，持续提高洗钱和恐怖融资风险管控水平。积极参与人民银行反洗钱数据治理试点工作，优化可疑交易监测模型，加大重点可疑交易分析力度，圆满完成了试点工作任务。本行严格履行反洗钱和反恐怖融资义务，落实各项监管政策，连续三年被人民银行评为A类机构。

修订完善了100多个制度，印发了规章制度汇编，借助“网络学院”“合规学堂”等活动平台，加强制度学习传导，开展合规教育，有效提升员工合规意识。

## （八）洗钱和恐怖融资风险管理对策

# Part IV · Various Risks and Risk Management Strategy

## 1. Types and Forms of Risk

The Bank is mainly faced with the following risks in operation: Credit risk, market risk, operational risk, liquidity risk, etc. The Bank positively took various effective measures to strive for preventing and dissolving the above risks.

## II. Risk Management Strategy

The Board of Directors of the Bank and its Risk Management Committee, along with the Senior Management and its Risk Management Committee shall be in charge of risk management and control of the Bank. A framework system in line with the supervisory requirements of modern banks has been established in various risk management and internal control through continuous coordination and promotion of the project construction of the comprehensive risk management system. According to the division of responsibilities, relevant departments shall be specifically responsible for the management and control over credit risk, market risk, operational risk, liquidity risk and other risks of the Bank.

#### (I) Countermeasures for Credit Risk Management

On the basis of serving the development of the real economy and effectively preventing the credit risk, the Bank constantly improved its credit system and mechanism, continuously optimized the authorization management mode and credit asset structure, centralized its credit approval authority, reduced the approval nodes, optimized the approval mode, took multiple measures to strengthen credit risk prevention and control, kept perfecting its credit management system and management mechanism, strengthened the control of risk sources and the risk control in the key areas, and pushed forward the handling of non-performing loans, realizing the scientific and continuous development of its credit business. The Bank incorporated the management of large-amount risk exposure into the comprehensive risk management system, measured and dynamically monitored the change of large-amount risk exposure, and effectively controlled the risk of customer concentration. By the end of the reporting period, the Bank's non-interbank single customers, non-interbank associated customers, interbank single customers and interbank group customers up to the standard of large-amount risk exposure met the regulatory requirements. The Bank actively changed its business mode, seriously implemented the green credit policy and continuously increased green financial innovation and credit investment in green economic fields such as energy conservation and environmental protection, circular economy and low-carbon economy, achieving good economic and social benefits.

### (II) Countermeasures for Liquidity Risk Management

The Bank continued to maintain a sound liquidity risk management strategy, attached great importance to the compliance management of liquidity indicators, implemented the monthly management mechanism of key liquidity indicators, planned the total business volume and structure in advance, predicted and analyzed the impact on liquidity indicators, and actively adjusted its business strategy. At the same time, the Bank continued to improve its ability for asset-liability management, expanded the channels of capital sources, ensured the appropriate total amount of liabilities, stable sources and diversified structure, made preparation and financing arrangements in advance, increased the reserve of high-quality liquidity assets, and strengthened the "safety pad" that should have an external impact. The 2020 liquidity risk indicators were generally controlled within a reasonable range, and the main liquidity regulatory indicators met the requirements.

#### (III) Countermeasures for Market Risk Management

The Bank constantly optimized the market risk monitoring and reporting mechanism, regularly analyzed business risks, strengthened market risk middle control and continued to enhance risk monitoring in the financial market and other relevant businesses by dispatching risk managers. According to the market conditions, the Bank formulated risk limit indicators, regularly monitored the use of indicators, and reported abnormality in a timely manner. The Bank established a reasonable market risk pressure test mechanism in accordance with the regulatory requirements, constantly improved the pressure test scenario, and improved its market risk measurement. At present, a quota structure system, including trading limits, stop-loss limits, and risk limits, has been established to identify, monitor, and control market risks. The Bank managed interest rate risks by adjusting the duration of assets and liabilities, and setting market risk limits, and avoided exchange rate risks by optimizing the structural combination of foreign exchange assets and liabilities. The Bank adopted the methods of gap analysis, duration analysis and interest rate risk sensitivity analysis to monitor the overall interest rate risk of managed assets and liability portfolio. Meanwhile, it introduced a series of risk indicators, such as bond portfolio income, market value evaluation and duration, to evaluate the risks of its bond business.

Relying on the internal control compliance and operational risk management system, on the basis of combing and optimizing the business and management activity processes, the Bank further identified the risk points and control points, carried out the operational risk and control self-evaluation work, continuously collected and monitored the key operational risk indicators, and promoted the refinement of operational risk management. The Bank made full use of online and offline resources to train tellers, account managers, financial managers and other key personnel, continued to improve the business level of employees, and strived to create an atmosphere of standardized operation. The Bank promoted the construction of information system automation, actively upgraded the operating system, standardized the business operation, and reduced the operational risk brought by the misoperation while improving the efficiency.

#### (IV) Countermeasures for Operational Risk Management

#### (V) Countermeasures for IT Risk Management

The Bank earnestly practiced the idea of "strengthening the Bank with science and technology", actively studied financial technology and service reform on the basis of the business development strategy, effectively enhanced the sense of mission of empowerment with science and technology, accelerated digital transformation, and led the development of information technology of the whole bank. Firstly, the Bank actively explored the transformation of the distributed micro-service structure, improved the high concurrency, flexible expansion and service sharing ability of system functions, and quickly promoted the construction of the information system through agile development. Secondly, the Bank started from the construction of big data intelligence, actively promoted data governance and application, established and improved the data standards and technical architecture, strengthened the scenario application analysis ability, and fully tapped data value. Thirdly, the Bank strictly implemented the responsibility for network security, refined the protection of network security and key information infrastructure protection measures, continued to carry out penetration testing and network security evaluation, and organized a comprehensive audit of information technology and a special audit of information technology outsourcing. By the end of the reporting period, no major network security incidents had occurred. Fourthly, the Bank continued to improve the business continuity system, carried out business impact analysis, organized actual combat business continuity drills, and fully verified the rationality and effectiveness of its emergency plan.

### (VI) Countermeasures for Reputational Risk Management

The Bank continued to take reputation risk prevention and control management as an important link of its high-quality safety operation, strengthened media cooperation and positive publicity and continued to strengthen public opinion monitoring, risk investigation and management efforts through strictly implementing regulatory requirements and conscientiously implementing work rules and regulations, planned ahead and early responded to key nodes and sensitive events, expanded the scope of reputation risk prevention work training, improved the reputation risk event response ability and red line awareness, and also took other work

measures. As a result, the overall reputation risk of the Bank was low and controllable. During the reporting period, the Bank handled 57 cases of various complaints and appeals for help, 11 of which were valid after investigation and analysis. The complaints mainly involved with business handling, services and credit cards, and mainly within the jurisdiction of Zibo City. After receiving the problems and complaints from customers, the Bank could effectively handle them according to the process and communicate with the customers in time. The completion rate of complaint handling of the Bank was 100%. By the end of the reporting period, the Bank had no significant reputation risk incident occurred, and continued to maintain safe operation.

##### (VII) Countermeasures for Compliance Risk Management

Adhering to the idea that "compliance is the cornerstone of development" and "compliance creates value", the Bank organized the activity of "Year of Deepening the Construction of Industry Standards", revised and improved more than 100 systems, issued a compilation of rules and regulations, strengthened the transmission of institutional learning, conducted compliance education and effectively enhanced employee compliance awareness by virtue of "Network College", "Compliance School" and other activity platforms.

#### (VIII) Countermeasures for Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Risk Management

The Bank continued to strengthen the risk management and control of money laundering and terrorist financing, and carried out continuous identification, prudent assessment, effective control and whole-process management for the risk of money laundering and terrorist financing. Through improving the money laundering and terrorist financing risk management system, the Bank improved its risk management structure, deepened the construction of the internal control system, improved the functions of the anti-money laundering system, strengthened the training of anti-money laundering personnel, and continuously improved the level of money laundering and terrorist financing risk control. The Bank actively participated in the pilot work of anti-money laundering data management of the People's Bank of China, optimized the monitoring model of suspicious transactions, strengthened the analysis of key suspicious transactions, and successfully completed the pilot work tasks. The Bank strictly fulfilled its obligations of anti-money laundering and anti-terrorist financing, implemented various regulatory policies, and had been rated as a Category A institution by the People's Bank of China for three consecutive years.

齐商银行股份有限公司全体股东：

## 一、审计意见

我们审计了齐商银行股份有限公司（以下简称齐商银行）财务报表，包括2020年12月31日的合并及母公司资产负债表，2020年度的合并及母公司利润表、合并及母公司现金流量表、合并及母公司股东权益变动表以及相关财务报表附注。

我们认为，后附的财务报表在所有重大方面按照企业会计准则的规定编制，公允反映了齐商银行2020年12月31日的合并及母公司财务状况以及2020年度的合并及母公司经营成果和现金流量。

## 二、形成审计意见的基础

我们按照中国注册会计师审计准则的规定执行了审计工作。审计报告的“注册会计师对财务报表审计的责任”部分进一步阐述了我们在这些准则下的责任。按照中国注册会计师职业道德守则，我们独立于齐商银行，并履行了职业道德方面的其他责任。我们相信，我们获取的审计证据是充分、适当的，为发表审计意见提供了基础。

## 三、管理层和治理层对财务报表的责任

齐商银行管理层（以下简称管理层）负责按照企业会计准则的规定编制财务报表，使其实现公允反映，并设计、执行和维护必要的内部控制，以使财务报表不存在由于舞弊或错误导致的重大错报。

在编制财务报表时，管理层负责评估齐商银行的持续经营能力，披露与持续经营相关的事项（如适用），并运用持续经营假设，除非计划进行清算、终止运营或别无其他现实的选择。

治理层负责监督齐商银行的财务报告过程。

## 四、注册会计师对财务报表审计的责任

我们的目标是对财务报表整体是否不存在由于舞弊或错误导致的重大错报获取合理保证，并出具包含审计意见的审计报告。合理保证是高水平的保证，但并不能保证按照审计准则执行的审计在某一重大错报存在时总能发现。错报可能由于舞弊或错误导致，如果合理预期错报单独或汇总起来可能影响财务报表使用者依据财务报表作出的经济决策，则通常认为错报是重大的。

在按照审计准则执行审计工作的过程中，我们运用职业判断，并保持职业怀疑。同时，我们也执行以下工作：

(1) 识别和评估由于舞弊或错误导致的财务报表重大错报风险，设计和实施审计程序以应对这些风

险，并获取充分、适当的审计证据，作为发表审计意见的基础。由于舞弊可能涉及串通、伪造、故意遗漏、虚假陈述或凌驾于内部控制之上，未能发现由于舞弊导致的重大错报的风险高于未能发现由于错误导致的重大错报的风险。

(2) 了解与审计相关的内部控制，以设计恰当的审计程序，但目的并非对内部控制的有效性发表意见。

(3) 评价管理层选用会计政策的恰当性和作出会计估计及相关披露的合理性。

（4）对管理层使用持续经营假设的恰当性得出结论。同时，根据获取的审计证据，就可能导致对齐商业银行持续经营能力产生重大疑虑的事项或情况是否存在重大不确定性得出结论。如果我们得出结论认为存在重大不确定性，审计准则要求我们在审计报告中提请报表使用者注意财务报表中的相关披露；如果披露不充分，我们应当发表非无保留意见。我们的结论基于截至审计报告日可获得的信息。然而，未来的事项或情况可能导致齐商银行不能持续经营。

(5) 评价财务报表的总体列报（包括披露）、结构和内容，并评价财务报表是否公允反映相关交易和事项。

(6) 就齐商银行中实体或业务活动的财务信息获取充分、适当的审计证据，以对合并财务报表发表审计意见。我们负责指导、监督和执行集团审计，并对审计意见承担全部责任。

我们与治理层就计划的审计范围、时间安排和重大审计发现等事项进行沟通，包括沟通我们在审计中识别出的值得关注的内部控制缺陷。

## 三、财务报表附注

## 一、公司基本情况

## (一) 公司概况

齐商银行股份有限公司（以下简称“本公司”或“齐商银行”）是1997年8月在城市信用合作社基础上成立并在山东省工商局注册的股份制金融企业。本公司原名淄博市商业银行股份有限公司，于2009年2月13日，经中国银监会批准更名为齐商银行股份有限公司。

本公司法定代表人：李大鹏；注册地址：淄博市张店区中心路105号；金融许可证号：B0171H237030001号；企业统一社会信用代码：913700001641139094。

经营范围主要包括：吸收公众存款；发放短期、中期和长期贷款；办理国内结算；办理票据承兑与贴现；发行金融债券；从事同业拆借；提供担保、代理保险、房屋租赁等；外汇存款；外汇贷款；外汇汇款；外币兑换；国际结算；同业外汇拆借；外汇票据的承兑和贴现；外汇借款；外汇担保；结汇、售汇；资信调查、咨询、鉴证业务。以及其他经中国银行业监督管理委员会依照有关法律、行政法规和其他规定批准的业务。

## (二) 合并财务报表范围

至2020年12月31日，本公司合并财务报表范围内子公司如下：

## 二、财务报表的编制基础

## (一) 编制基础

公司以持续经营为基础，根据实际发生的交易和事项，按照财政部颁布的《企业会计准则——基本准则》和具体会计准则、企业会计准则应用指南、企业会计准则解释及其他相关规定(以下合称“企业会计准则”)编制财务报表。

## (二) 持续经营

公司自本报告期末至少12个月内具备持续经营能力，无影响持续经营能力的重大事项。

## 三、重要会计政策及会计估计

## (一) 遵循企业会计准则的声明

公司所编制的财务报表符合企业会计准则的要求，真实、完整地反映了报告期公司的财务状况、经营成果、现金流量等有关信息。

## (二) 会计期间

自公历1月1日起至12月31日止为一个会计年度。

## (三) 营业周期

本公司营业周期为12个月。

## (四) 记账本位币

本公司采用人民币为记账本位币。

(五) 以下注释项目除特别注明之外，金额单位为人民币元。

## (六) 合并财务报表的编制方法

### 1. 合并范围

本公司合并财务报表的合并范围以控制为基础确定，所有子公司（包括本公司所控制的单独主体）均纳入合并财务报表。

### 2. 合并程序

本公司以自身和各子公司的财务报表为基础，根据其他有关资料，编制合并财务报表。本公司编制合并财务报表，将整个企业集团视为一个会计主体，依据相关企业会计准则的确认、计量和列报要求，按照统一的会计政策，反映本公司集团整体财务状况、经营成果和现金流量。

所有纳入合并财务报表合并范围的子公司所采用的会计政策、会计期间与本公司一致。

## (七) 现金及现金等价物

在编制现金流量表时，将本公司库存现金以及可以随时用于支付的存款确认为现金。

将同时具备期限短（从购买日起三个月内到期）、流动性强、易于转换为已知现金、价值变动风险很小四个条件的投资，确定为现金等价物。包括存放中央银行款项（扣除法定存款准备金）、存放同业款项、拆出资金、买入返售金融资产。

## (八) 外币业务和外币报表折算

### 1. 外币业务

外币业务采用交易发生日的即期汇率作为折算汇率将外币金额折合成人民币记账。

资产负债表日外币货币性项目余额按资产负债表日即期汇率折算，由此产生的汇兑差额，除属于与购建符合资本化条件的资产相关的外币专门借款产生的汇兑差额按照借款费用资本化的原则处理外，均计入当期损益。

### 2. 外币财务报表的折算

资产负债表中的资产和负债项目，采用资产负债表日的即期汇率折算；所有者权益项目除“未分配利润”项目外，其他项目采用发生时的即期汇率折算。利润表中的收入和费用项目，采用交易发生日的即期汇率折算。

## (九) 买入返售金融资产和卖出回购金融资产款

买入返售是指按合同或协议规定，以一定的价格向交易对手买入相关资产（包括债券、票据及贷款等），到合同规定日期，再以规定价格返售给对方的合同。买入返售金融资产按买入相关资产时实际支付的金额入账。

卖出回购是指按合同或协议规定，以一定的价格将相关资产（包括债券、票据及贷款等）出售给交易对手，到合同规定日期，再以规定价格回购的合同。卖出回购金融资产款按卖出相关资产时实际收到的金额入账。

## (十) 长期股权投资

### 1. 共同控制、重大影响的判断标准

共同控制，是指按照相关约定对某项安排所共有的控制，并且该安排的相关活动必须经过分享控制权的参与方一致同意后才能决策。本公司与其他合营方一同对被投资单位实施共同控制且对被投资单位净资产享有权利的，被投资单位为本公司的合营企业。

重大影响，是指对一个企业的财务和经营决策有参与决策的权力，但并不能够控制或者与其他方一起共同控制这些政策的制定。本能够对被投资单位施加重大影响的，被投资单位为本公司联营企业。

### 2. 初始投资成本的确定

#### (1) 企业合并形成的长期股权投资

同一控制下的企业合并：公司以支付现金、转让非现金资产或承担债务方式以及以发行权益性证券作为合并对价的，在合并日按照取得被合并方所有者权益在最终控制方合并财务报表中的账面价值的份额作为长期股权投资的初始投资成本。

#### (2) 其他方式取得的长期股权投资

以支付现金方式取得的长期股权投资，按照实际支付的购买价款作为初始投资成本。

以发行权益性证券取得的长期股权投资，按照发行权益性证券的公允价值作为初始投资成本。

##### (1) 成本法核算的长期股权投资

### 3. 后续计量及损益确认方法

公司对子公司的长期股权投资，采用成本法核算。除取得投资时实际支付的价款或对价中包含的已宣告但尚未发放的现金股利或利润外，公司按照享有被投资单位宣告发放的现金股利或利润确认当期投资收益。

#### (2) 权益法核算的长期股权投资

对联营企业和合营企业的长期股权投资，采用权益法核算。初始投资成本大于投资时应享有被投资单位可辨认净资产公允价值份额的差额，不调整长期股权投资的初始投资成本；初始投资成本小于投资时应享有被投资单位可辨认净资产公允价值份额的差额，计入当期损益。

## (十一) 固定资产

### 1. 固定资产确认条件

固定资产指为生产商品、提供劳务、出租或经营管理而持有，并且使用寿命超过一个会计年度的有形

资产。固定资产在同时满足下列条件时予以确认：

(1) 与该固定资产有关的经济利益很可能流入企业；

(2) 该固定资产的成本能够可靠地计量。

## 2. 各类固定资产的折旧方法

固定资产折旧采用年限平均法分类计提，根据固定资产类别、预计使用寿命和预计净残值率确定折旧率。如固定资产各组成部分的使用寿命不同或者以不同方式为企业提供经济利益，则选择不同折旧率或折旧方法，分别计提折旧。

融资租赁方式租入的固定资产，能合理确定租赁期届满时将会取得租赁资产所有权的，在租赁资产尚可使用年限内计提折旧；无法合理确定租赁期届满时能够取得租赁资产所有权的，在租赁期与租赁资产尚可使用年限两者中较短的期间内计提折旧。

主要固定资产类别的折旧年限如下：


<table border=1 style='margin: auto; word-wrap: break-word;'><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>资产类别</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>折旧年限</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>房屋及建筑物</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>30年</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>电子设备</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>3年</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>机器设备</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>5年</td></tr><tr><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>运输工具及其他</td><td style='text-align: center; word-wrap: break-word;'>5年</td></tr></table>

### (十二) 在建工程

在建工程项目按建造该项资产达到预定可使用状态前所发生的必要支出，作为固定资产的入账价值。所建造的固定资产在建工程已达到预定可使用状态，但尚未办理竣工决算的，自达到预定可使用状态之日起，根据工程预算、造价或者工程实际成本等，按估计的价值转入固定资产，并按本公司固定资产折旧政策计提固定资产的折旧，待办理竣工决算后，再按实际成本调整原来的暂估价值，但不调整原已计提的折旧额。

### (十三) 无形资产

1. 无形资产的计价方法

(1) 公司取得无形资产时按成本进行初始计量；

#### (2) 后续计量

在取得无形资产时分析判断其使用寿命。

对于使用寿命有限的无形资产，在为企业带来经济利益的期限内按直线法摊销；无法预见无形资产为企业带来经济利益期限的，视为使用寿命不确定的无形资产，不予摊销。

## 2. 无形资产的使用寿命估计情况

每期末，对无形资产的使用寿命及摊销方法进行复核。

## 3. 无形资产减值准备的计提

对于使用寿命确定的无形资产，如有明显减值迹象的，期末进行减值测试。

对于使用寿命不确定的无形资产，每期末进行减值测试。

对无形资产进行减值测试，估计其可收回金额。

无形资产的减值损失一经确认，在以后会计期间不再转回。

### (十四) 长期资产减值

长期股权投资、采用成本模式计量的投资性房地产、固定资产、在建工程、无形资产等长期资产，于资产负债表日存在减值迹象的，进行减值测试。减值测试结果表明资产的可收回金额低于其账面价值的，按其差额计提减值准备并计入减值损失。可收回金额为资产的公允价值减去处置费用后的净额与资产预计未来现金流量的现值两者之间的较高者。资产减值准备按单项资产为基础计算并确认，如果难以对单项资产的可收回金额进行估计的，以该资产所属的资产组确定资产组的可收回金额。资产组是能够独立产生现金流入的最小资产组合。

### (十五) 其他资产

## 1. 长期待摊费用

长期待摊费用是指已经支出但应由本期和以后各期负担的分摊期限在一年以上（不含一年）的各项费用。

抵债资产按取得时的公允价值入帐，公允价值与相关资产账面价值及支付的税费之间的差额计入当期损益。

## 2. 抵债资产

抵债资产处置时，如果取得的处置收入大于抵债资产账面价值，其差额计入营业外收入；如果取得的处置收入小于抵债资产账面价值，其差额计入营业外支出；保管过程中发生的费用直接计入其他业务支出。处置过程中发生的费用，从处置收入中抵减。

## 3. 其他应收款项

本公司按照其他应收款的项目和对方单位（个人）进行明细核算。本公司定期分析各项其他应收款项的可收回性，当应收款项的可收回金额低于其账面价值时，计提资产减值准备，并计入当期损益。

### (十六) 职工薪酬

## 1. 短期薪酬的会计处理方法

本公司在职工为本公司提供服务的会计期间，将实际发生的短期薪酬确认为负债，并计入当期损益或相关资产成本。

本公司为职工缴纳的社会保险费和住房公积金，以及按规定提取的工会经费和职工教育经费，在职工为本公司提供服务的会计期间，根据规定的计提基础和计提比例计算确定相应的职工薪酬金额。

职工福利费为非货币性福利的，如能够可靠计量的，按照公允价值计量。

## 2. 离职后福利的会计处理方法

#### (1) 设定提存计划

本公司按当地政府的相关规定为职工缴纳基本养老保险和失业保险，在职工为本公司提供服务的会计期间，按以当地规定的缴纳基数和比例计算应缴纳金额，确认为负债，并计入当期损益或相关资产成本。

除基本养老保险外，本公司还依据国家企业年金制度的相关政策建立了企业年金计划。本公司按职工工资总额的一定比例向年金计划缴费，相应支出计入当期损益或相关资产成本。

#### (2) 设定受益计划

本公司根据预期累计福利单位法确定的公式将设定受益计划产生的福利义务归属于职工提供服务的期间，并计入当期损益或相关资产成本。

## 3. 辞退福利的会计处理方法

本公司在不能单方面撤回因解除劳动关系计划或裁减建议所提供的辞退福利时，或确认与涉及支付辞退福利的重组相关的成本或费用时（两者孰早），确认辞退福利产生的职工薪酬负债，并计入当期损益。

### (十七) 收入确认

收入在相关的经济利益很可能流入本公司且金额能够可靠计量，同时满足以下不同类型收入的其他确认条件时，予以确认。

## 1. 利息收入

金融资产的利息收入根据让渡资金使用权的时间和实际利率在计入当期损益。利息收入包括折价或溢价的摊销，当实际利率与合同利率差异不大时，采用合同利率。

当一项金融资产或一组类似的金融资产确认减值损失后，确认利息收入所使用的利率为计量减值损失时对未来现金流进行贴现时使用的利率。

## 2. 手续费和佣金收入

手续费和佣金收入在提供相关服务时，根据权责发生制的原则确认。

资产买卖、或参与第三方进行资产买卖交易（如购买客户贷款、证券，或出售业务）时产生的手续费于相关交易完成时确认。

## 3. 股利收入

非上市权益工具投资的股利收入于本公司收取股利权力时确认计入当期损益，计入投资收益。

### (十八)递延所得税资产和递延所得税负债

对于可抵扣暂时性差异确认递延所得税资产，以未来期间很可能取得的用来抵扣可抵扣暂时性差异的应纳税所得额为限。对于能够结转以后年度的可抵扣亏损和税款抵减，以很可能获得用来抵扣可抵扣亏损和税款抵减的未来应纳税所得额为限，确认相应的递延所得税资产。

对于应纳税暂时性差异，除特殊情况外，确认递延所得税负债。

不确认递延所得税资产或递延所得税负债的特殊情况包括：商誉的初始确认；除企业合并以外的发生时既不影响会计利润也不影响应纳税所得额（或可抵扣亏损）的其他交易或事项。

当拥有以净额结算的法定权利，且意图以净额结算或取得资产、清偿负债同时进行时，当期所得税资产及当期所得税负债以抵销后的净额列报。

当拥有以净额结算当期所得税资产及当期所得税负债的法定权利，且递延所得税资产及递延所得税负债是与同一税收征管部门对同一纳税主体征收的所得税相关或者是对不同的纳税主体相关，但在未来每一具有重要性的递延所得税资产及负债转回的期间内，涉及的纳税主体意图以净额结算当期所得税资产和负债或是同时取得资产、清偿负债时，递延所得税资产及递延所得税负债以抵销后的净额列报。

本公司通常作为受托人在受托业务中为信托机构、其他机构和零售客户管理资产。受托业务中所涉及的资产不属于本公司，因此不包括在本公司财务报表中。

### (十九) 委托业务

委托贷款是指本公司接受委托，由客户（作为委托人）提供资金，由本公司（作为受托人）按照委托人确定的贷款对象、用途、金额、期限、利率而代理发放和监督使用并由本公司协助收回的贷款，风险由委托人承担。本公司进行委托贷款业务只收取手续费，不代垫资金，不承担信用风险。

### (二十) 债务重组

债务重组，是指在债务人发生财务困难的情况下，本公司作为债权人按照其与债务人达成的协议或者法院的裁定作出让步的事项。债务重组的方式主要包括：（一）以资产清偿债务；（二）将债务转为资本；（三）修改其他债务条件；（四）以上三种方式的组合等。

以现金清偿债务的，本公司将重组债权的账面余额与收到的现金之间的差额，计入当期损益。本公司已对债权计提减值准备的，先将该差额冲减减值准备，减值准备不足以冲减的部分，计入当期损益。

以非现金资产清偿债务的，本公司对受让的非现金资产按其公允价值入账，重组债权的账面余额与受让的非现金资产的公允价值之间的差额，比照以现金清偿债务的规定处理。

将债务转为资本的，本公司将享有股份的公允价值确认为对债务人的投资，重组债权的账面余额与股份的公允价值之间的差额，比照以现金清偿债务的规定处理。

修改其他债务条件的，本公司将修改其他债务条件后的债权的公允价值作为重组后债权的账面价值，重组债权的账面余额与重组后债权的账面价值之间的差额，比照以现金清偿债务的规定处理。修改后的债务条款中涉及或有应收金额的，本公司不确认或有应收金额，不将其计入重组后债权的账面价值。

债务重组采用以现金清偿债务、非现金资产清偿债务、债务转为资本、修改其他债务条件等方式的组合进行的，本公司依次以收到的现金、接受的非现金资产公允价值、债权人享有股份的公允价值冲减重组债权的账面余额，再按照修改其他债务条件的规定处理。

2017年11月13日，经中国银监会山东监管局下发《山东银监局关于齐商银行发行二级资本债券的批复》[鲁银监准(2017)369号]文批准，同意本公司在全国银行间债券市场发行金额不超过30亿元人民币的二级资本债券；2018年2月14日，中国人民银行下发《中国人民银行准予行政许可决定书》[银市场许准予字(2018)第24号]文依法作出准予行政许可的决定；2018年6月27日，本公司发行2018年齐商银行股份有限公司二级资本债券（第一期），债券代码1820031，主承销商为中信建投证券股份有限公司，发行总额人民币5亿元，发行价格100元/百元面值，票面利率5.4%；2019年9月23日，本公司发行2019年齐商银行股份有限公司二级资本债券（第一期），债券代码1920058，主承销商为中信建投证券股份有限公司，发行总额人民币10亿元，发行价格100元/百元面值，票面利率5.4%。

(一) 表外业务是指所有不在资产负债表中反映的业务，包括两部分：

或有风险的表外业务，即为客户债务清偿能力提供担保、承担客户违约风险的业务，如贷款承诺等；无风险的表外业务主要包括结算、代理业务。

### 八、主要表外项目

1. 银行承兑汇票是由承兑申请人向本公司申请，经本公司审查同意承兑的商业汇票。

2. 信用证指本公司根据申请人的要求和指示，向收益人开立的载有一定金额，在一定期限内凭规定的单据在指定地点付款的书面保证文件。

3. 银行保函指本公司应申请人或委托人的要求，以出具保函的形式向收益人承诺，当申请人不履行合同约定的义务或承诺的事项时，由本公司按保函约定履行债务或承担责任的信贷业务。

### (一) 受托贷款及受托存款

本公司替第三方贷款人发放委托贷款。本公司作为中介人根据提供资金的第三方贷款人的意愿向借款人发放贷款，并与第三方贷款人签立合同约定负责替其管理和回收贷款。第三方贷款人自行决定委托贷款的要求和条款，包括贷款用途、金额、利率及还款安排。本公司收取委托贷款的手续费一般为一次性收费，但贷款发生损失的风险由第三方贷款人承担。

### (四) 诉讼事项

### 十一、资产负债表日后事项

2021年4月28日，本公司第七届董事会第十一次会议通过2020年度利润分配预案，按税后利润的10%提取法定盈余公积55,942,597.18元，提取一般风险准备210,000,000.00元，以2021年3月31日总股本3,887,921,566股为基数，向全体股东每10股派发现金股利0.8625元（含税），共派发现金股利335,333,235.00元。上述分配方案尚待股东大会批准。

除上述事项外，截至2021年4月28日，本公司不存在其他应披露的资产负债表日后重大事项。

### 十二、资本充足情况

本公司资本管理以资本充足率和资本回报率为核心，目标是密切结合发展规划，实现规模扩张与盈利能力、资本总量与结构优化、最佳资本规模与资本回报的科学统一。

本公司综合考虑监管机构指标、行业的平均水平、自身发展速度、资本补充的时间性和保持净资产收益率的稳定增长等因素，确定合理的资本充足率管理的目标区间。该目标区间不低于监管要求。

本公司根据中国银行保险监督管理委员会2012年6月下发的《商业银行资本管理办法(试行)》计算资本充足率。信用风险加权资产计量采用权重法，市场风险加权资产计量采用标准法，操作风险加权资产计量采用基本指标法。

本公司于2020年12月31日根据《商业银行资本管理办法(试行)》计算的监管资本状况如下：

本公司不断加强不良资产管控力度，做好不良贷款的管控压降工作。一是强化管控措施，提高处置实效。严格落实“早识别、早监测、早预警、早处置、早问责”要求，将管控任务目标逐级逐项分解细化，加强不良清收工作的统一指导，按季考核、按月通报、按周调度，抓进度督导、抓排名通报、抓经验交流，力促不良资产清收处置工作取得应有实效。二是坚持提升内部管理能力，随时关注形势变化、及时了解企业状况，尤其是加大重点区域、重点行业、重点客户的监测、分析、预警力度。三是完善管理体制机制。强化现金清收，充分借助律师、工商、税务、第三方中介机构等，挖掘有利线索，通过专职清收、风险代理、公开处置等手段，进一步提高不良贷款清收的针对性、有效性；优化考核机制，强化考核措施，完善激励政策，突出全员考核，充分调动各方面的积极性，确保奖惩科学、举措有力。四是加强清收团队建设。立足当前实际，通过优化内部人力资源，配齐配足清收人员，增强团队力量、实施有效激励、提供资源支持，综合运用追偿、重组、拍卖、救助、转让等多种手段，加大自身清收力度。
